reason: Approved pre-launch Product audit WP-1 requires Chinese-first normal-user Product surfaces, one durable global typography contract at 85%-150% in 1% steps, and one global theme experience across the pinned Element host plus Yance Product/Media/Voice/Presence/Learning surfaces. Fresh source audit found the existing Yance Store/themeAppearancePolicy is already the durable appearance authority but clamps fontScale to 90-120; the existing Store REST route already writes theme preferences, while the Electron Store bridge lacks only that narrow write seam. Pinned Element Web v1.12.25 already owns font/theme application through SettingsStore, FontSizeController/FontWatcher and ThemeWatcher, but its public module SettingsApi is read-only. This authorization therefore permits only the correct-layer authority range correction, a narrow existing Store bridge/catalog projection, a minimal replayable Element appearance module seam that delegates to Element's existing authorities, semantic token migration, Chinese-first copy, and extension of existing typography/theme audits to the shipping Element module. No second theme/font engine, registry, persistence authority, dependency, workflow, send route, model, learning or messaging runtime is authorized.

freshSourceFindings: backend/store/themeAppearancePolicy.js imports frontend/theme-catalog.json and is already the single catalog-backed appearance policy; normalizeTypography currently clamps fontScale to 90-120.
backend/routes/store.js already exposes PUT /api/r32/store/ui/theme/preferences backed by UPDATE_THEME_PREFERENCES and Store persistence.
electron/r32StoreBridge.js and electron/preload.js expose Store snapshot/theme apply/preview seams but do not expose the existing theme-preferences write route.

frontend/r32-theme-semantic-contract.css and frontend/r32-global-reading.css already define the repository semantic theme and typography roles; ProductExperienceShell.css currently defines a private --yance-* palette and hard-coded component font sizes.
tools/uat/fix6d-global-typography-audit.js and scripts/audit-theme-colors.js currently scan historical frontend scope but not the shipping integration/element-module.

Shipping Media/Voice/Presence/Learning normal-user surfaces contain English runtime/status copy and implementation names including Immich, ComfyUI, CyberVerse, SoulX, SenseVoice, CosyVoice, Langfuse, DSPy, GEPA, Promptfoo, OpenFeature, flagd and Letta.
Pinned Element Web v1.12.25 commit a2a996ae50d802878bf48e4bbf3730004bdcc55c exposes SettingsApi.getValue only; no public module appearance write exists.

Pinned Element already applies font changes through SettingsStore fontSizeDelta -> FontSizeController -> FontWatcher and theme changes through SettingsStore theme/use_system_theme/custom_themes -> existing ThemeWatcher/RecheckTheme.

Pinned Element custom themes are a mature built-in capability and accept colors plus Compound semantic token overrides; WP-1 may adapt the existing Yance theme catalog into that capability without forking a theme engine.
tools/matrix/bootstrap.js already replays exact numbered Element patches through 0013; an authorized 0014 must be explicitly apply --check then applied rather than introducing a broad patch loader.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

appearanceAuthorityContract.durableAuthority: existing Yance Store ui appearance state normalized by backend/store/themeAppearancePolicy.js
requiredBehavior: Expose the existing Store theme-preferences write through the existing Electron Store bridge/preload rather than adding another persistence path.

If Product needs theme metadata/tokens, expose a narrow read-only projection from the existing themeAppearancePolicy/catalog through the existing Store route/bridge layer; do not copy the catalog into Product source.
Project the canonical Yance appearance state into the pinned Element host through the authorized Element appearance seam so Element main UI and Yance Product descendants change together.

At startup and after user changes, reconcile Element derived appearance from the Yance Store canonical state; Element settings are rendering/application mechanisms, not a second Yance canonical authority.

Map existing Yance theme catalog values to Element's existing custom-theme capability using documented Element custom theme color/Compound semantic token inputs; do not fork theme selection/rendering.
Product Shell, Media, Voice, Presence, Learning and Product overlays consume semantic theme/typography roles only; no Product-private palette or typography registry remains.
Existing send, route, composer, timeline, model, Learning and platform runtime authorities remain unchanged.
forbiddenBehavior: No rootNode/document style hack as the production global typography mechanism.
No Product-localStorage persistence for global appearance.
No second theme catalog, second font registry, second CSS authority or new general-purpose appearance runtime.
No late !important override layer used to fake semantic migration.
No workflow/scanner exclusions added merely to allow Product CSS through.

requiredBehavior: Add a narrow public module appearance API instead of making SettingsApi a general write API.

Font-scale application must delegate to Element SettingsStore/FontSizeController/FontWatcher at DEVICE scope and validate the Yance-approved 85-150 integer percent contract before conversion to Element's existing fontSizeDelta authority.

Theme application must delegate to Element's existing theme/custom_themes/use_system_theme settings and ThemeWatcher/RecheckTheme path; it may accept a typed Element CustomTheme projection but must not implement an independent theme engine.
The module API must expose only appearance operations; it must not expose arbitrary SettingsStore writes, MatrixClient, tokens, sync control, messaging sends or runtime control.
Add/update pinned Element unit coverage for the appearance seam and generated textual module API report only within the authorized upstream path set.
Remain an ordinary replayable textual patch against the exact pinned Element commit.
bootstrapReplay: tools/matrix/bootstrap.js must declare the exact 0014 patch path.
The existing bootstrap must git apply --check and apply 0014 after the prior numbered module API patches, with no broad glob/directory auto-loader.

requiredBehavior: Normal product navigation, buttons, status, empty states, errors and settings are Chinese-first.
Normal UI hides implementation/vendor names and presents capabilities; technical reason/error codes may remain only as secondary diagnostics after a Chinese explanation.
Foreign-language chat original/sent text remains authoritative; Chinese understanding is a separate display projection and is never substituted for the actual sent body.
Global font control is 85%-150%, default 100%, integer 1% steps, persisted through existing Store appearance authority and applied to Element host plus all Yance shipping surfaces.

Global theme switching is persisted through existing Store appearance authority and applied to Element host plus all Yance shipping surfaces using existing Element theme capability and Yance semantic tokens.
Product CSS uses repository semantic roles for surface/text/accent/status/focus and semantic type roles; component hard-coded text sizes do not escape global scaling.
Existing #478 active-room canonical relationship tool route binding remains unchanged.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not change relationship/send/media/voice/presence/Learning runtime identity or authority to accomplish presentation closure.
Do not expose LiteLLM, Langfuse, DSPy, GEPA, Promptfoo, OpenFeature, flagd, Letta, Immich, ComfyUI, CyberVerse, SoulX, SenseVoice or CosyVoice as ordinary primary UI labels.
Do not replace foreign original chat/candidate text with a Chinese translation.
Do not turn the Product UI into CRM, marketing, service desk, KPI or runtime-operations dashboards.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: Before production changes, focused tests prove current fontScale 85/150 behavior fails against the old 90-120 authority.
Focused tests prove the existing Electron bridge/preload lacks the theme-preferences write seam needed to use the existing Store persistence authority.
Pinned Element contract test proves current public module API has no appearance write seam and requires the exact 0014 patch/replay.
Product tests prove current normal-user Product/Media/Voice/Presence/Learning surfaces expose English/internal implementation names contrary to the approved contract.
Typography/theme audit tests prove the existing global scanners omit integration/element-module and current Product CSS contains private palette/hard-coded type escapes.
The first implementation commit changes only the exact authorized nine test files and produces causal RED before any production path changes.
